purpose: Matched saved-Qwen prefix/full-sequence interface comparison and additive-versus-joint scoring in identical action-dependent physics
model_parameters: All original P6 nominal values unchanged, including 30x100ms intervals, mission switch at15, switch charge .2, 96 seeds starting60912000

interfaces.prefix_H1: Truncate each saved two-command candidate to its first command; same raw candidate records and compiler calls. Each interval select minimum one-step score among verified prefixes. Duplicate prefixes share action semantics and are reported.
interfaces.sequence_execute2: Existing P6 actual sequence execution: select first by H2 belief-tree score, then reverify submitted continuations next interval and execute the best admitted continuation; replan on rejection or mission change.

interpretation: A saved-content-matched whole-interface intervention. Selection horizon and continuation execution both change; not a separately prompted single-action model and not a unique causal effect of continuation alone.
additive_proxy: At identical observed state and command, Ladd(z)=Ljoint(normal)+sum_r z_r*(Ljoint(single_r)-Ljoint(normal)). No clipping, even if extrapolation is negative; retain raw values. Overhead/switch charges are identical.
physics: Always the original joint queue dynamics, even when additive scores choose actions. Fixed-path reevaluation and matched score-induced replanning are reported separately.
references: Full-library H2 under both scoring modes, each on its own path; no global optimum/regret claim.
primary_inferential_unit: 96 independent exogenous episode seeds; average three generation replicates within seed first. Two fixed mission texts/segments do not support mission-population inference.

planned_contrasts.definition: On joint-score fixed paths, (sequence additive evaluator-prefix additive evaluator)-(sequence joint evaluator-prefix joint evaluator)

statistics.rawp_scope: Only the four planned contrasts; submitted for pooled multiplicity adjustment. All other intervals descriptive.

descriptive.semantics: Mission-specific weighted service utility and realized mission/action predicates are operational proxies; no independently elicited intent-alignment score.

latency.included: One belief update-to-marginals, finite-K vectorized admission and expected-score ranking over precomputed eight-mode utility rows
latency.excluded: Model API, diagnostic feature extraction, full H2 tree, hardware actuation, network and flight deadlines
latency.catalogue: Synthetic finite catalogue rows benchmark selection workload, not new physical action primitives; report workload construction and host.

preservation: Prior P6 files and all raw generation outputs remain unchanged.
